def remove_duplicates(nums):
    k = 0                              # write pointer
    for x in nums:
        if k < 2 or x != nums[k - 2]:  # at most two copies
            nums[k] = x
            k += 1
    return k

def sort_colors(nums):
    count = [0, 0, 0]
    for x in nums:                     # pass 1: tally
        count[x] += 1
    i = 0
    for color in range(3):             # pass 2: overwrite
        for _ in range(count[color]):
            nums[i] = color
            i += 1
